scope: Sleeper regular seasons 2020–2025; archived scored starters and bench only
method: Observed points divided by ex-post nine-slot optimum from recorded starters and bench, averaged across research-comparable weeks. Assumes QB RB RB WR WR TE FLEX FLEX DEF, FLEX permits RB/WR/TE. Not documented game-time availability or certified pre-lock legality.
limitations: Historical IR/taxi eligibility and in-game statuses not comprehensively recovered.
Nonstandard or vacant starter observations excluded with reasons; never assign 0%/N/A as scored value.
The 2016–2019 ESPN years do not have equivalent roster snapshots.
2026 Week 8 is a separately sourced current-season benchmark; excluded from completed-year history.
Mean percentages represent hindsight optimality, not coaching skill or official Sleeper all-season source statistic.
2025 weekly sources use documented WAR roster reconstructions for Weeks 1 and 7; remaining weeks use Sleeper snapshots.
